requirement_vague: Reset a password with an invalid reset token and confirm the reset is rejected.

omissions.description: The service does not implement any reset-password operation that accepts a token and new_password, so an invalid reset token cannot be rejected with the required 400 response and detail message.
omissions.reasoning: The code defines login at POST /api/v1/login/access-token and password change for the current user at PATCH /api/v1/users/me/password, but there is no reset-password route anywhere in the application. Therefore the specified call using body {"new_password":"changethis","token":"invalid"} cannot be made.

omissions.description: There is no logic to validate a password reset token and return HTTP 400 with JSON detail exactly "Invalid token" when the token is invalid.
omissions.reasoning: The only password-related handler is update_password_me, which checks current_password and new_password for an authenticated user. No code parses or validates a reset token, and no handler raises HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Invalid token") for password reset attempts.
